## Appearance

Commander Farragut is a good-looking officer.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P27](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0027)_

## Personality

Commander Farragut is driven by a strong determination to eliminate the monster from the oceans. He has formally sworn an oath to successfully rid the seas of this creature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000)_

## History

Commander Farragut welcomed [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) before the frigate set sail from [Brooklyn](../codex/places.md#brooklyn) to hunt a reported sea monster. Along with expert harpooner [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), he led his crew in an eager search for the creature across the [Atlantic](../codex/places.md#north-atlantic) and [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Oceans. As months passed without success and crew frustration grew, Farragut agreed to turn the ship back if the monster was not found within three days, a deadline that was met on its final evening when [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) spotted the target.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P27](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P43](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), +6 more_
